annotator.notes: Multi-turn scaffolding for a string manipulation problem. Tutor guides the student through string conversion, conditional logic for the shift limit, and slicing.

task_context.problem_statement:
def circular_shift(x, shift):
    """Circular shift the digits of the integer x, shift the digits right by shift
    and return the result as a string.
    If shift > number of digits, return digits reversed.
    >>> circular_shift(12, 1)
    "21"
    >>> circular_shift(12, 2)
    "12"
    """
